Terms of service

The rules that apply when you buy or use Webco Cloud services.

Last updated 5 October 2026

1. Who these terms are with

These terms are between you and Webco Services Ltd (company number 10607383), trading as Webco Cloud. Registered office: 2 Laurel House, 1 Station Road, Worle, Weston-Super-Mare, United Kingdom, BS22 6AR.

Contact: support@webcocloud.net.

2. Services

Webco Cloud provides:

  • Website packages (such as Essential and Professional), designed and built by Webco Media
  • Hosting, SSL, domain registration or connection, and business email as described on the site
  • Managed Care, where selected, for hosting plus routine maintenance and content updates
  • Customer tools such as the client area, webmail and hosting login

Package features, prices and inclusions on the website at the time you order form part of the contract, together with these terms and any written confirmation we send you.

3. Ordering and payment

  • Website package fees are charged at checkout for the build and setup described for that package.
  • Where Managed Care is added, the first Managed Care charge is due as stated at checkout (typically after a short trial period), then monthly while it remains active. Hosting is included in Managed Care while it is active.
  • Without Managed Care, standard hosting renews annually after the included first period, at the rate shown on the site when you order (or as we notify you before renewal).
  • Domain and other renewals are charged when due so the name and related services can continue.
  • Payments are processed by our payment provider. You must provide accurate billing details.

4. Website projects

You must provide the content, logos, photos and decisions we reasonably need to complete the site. Delays on your side can delay launch. The finished site is customised for your business; live demos on this site are examples, not the final product.

You confirm you have the rights to material you supply. You grant us and Webco Media permission to use that material to deliver the project.

5. Hosting, domains and email

  • We aim to keep hosting available, but no online service is perfect. Planned maintenance may occur.
  • Domain registration depends on the registry and on accurate registrant details you provide.
  • Email mailboxes are set up as agreed at the start. You are responsible for passwords, device settings and how mailboxes are used day to day.
  • You must keep contact and renewal details up to date so we can reach you before domains or services expire.

6. Managed Care

Managed Care covers hosting and a reasonable monthly allowance of routine content changes, as described on the hosting pages. Unused time does not roll over. Larger redesigns, new sections or work outside the allowance are quoted separately. You can cancel Managed Care by notice to us; hosting then continues on the standard renewal basis unless you cancel hosting as well.

7. Acceptable use

You must not use Webco Cloud services to:

  • Break the law, or store or send unlawful, harmful or abusive content
  • Send spam or run phishing, malware or similar abuse
  • Attack, overload or interfere with our systems or other customers
  • Try to gain unauthorised access to accounts, mailboxes or infrastructure

We may suspend or restrict a service if we reasonably believe it is being misused, or to protect the platform or other customers. We will try to contact you first where practical.

8. Cancellation and refunds

Digital services and custom website work begin once your order is accepted. Refunds are not automatic after work has started or after mailboxes, domains or hosting have been provisioned. If something has gone wrong on our side, contact us and we will look at a fair remedy. Domain fees paid to registries are often non-refundable.

9. Liability

Nothing in these terms limits liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or any other liability that cannot be limited by law.

Subject to that, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit, or loss of data to the extent the law allows. Our total liability for any claim relating to a service is limited to the fees you paid us for that service in the 12 months before the claim.

10. Changes

We may update these terms for legal, operational or product reasons. Material changes will be posted on this page with a new “Last updated” date. Continued use after the change means you accept the updated terms for ongoing services.

11. Law

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. The courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction, without affecting any mandatory consumer rights that may apply if you are contracting as a consumer.

These terms describe how we work with customers. They are not a substitute for advice about your own legal position.
